method: Independent source and existing receipt review. No test, build, browser, or release process launched by this lane.

evidence: Installed Vitest is 4.1.11. svg-caption-red-001 and svg-caption-green-001 logs show actual Vitest 4.1.11 executing with --maxWorkers=1.
release.sh's mandatory unit-tests row invokes pnpm -s exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1. The resource-policy allowlist, resource guard filtered-test prefix, and release fixture agree.
a_acceptance.open: The scoped receipts run only the scrape suite. No full release.sh receipt yet proves the mandatory unit-tests row and all other checks complete on the current integration. Root owns that run.

b_doctrine_quality.evidence: cb6b85e6 leaves memory, CPU, disk, swap, process ownership, and exact-command admission logic unchanged. It removes only unsupported --minWorkers=1 while requiring --maxWorkers=1, so worker-count admission remains single-worker.
b_doctrine_quality.limit: The release fixture matches the new command text but substitutes a fake pnpm response; it is not proof of Vitest execution. The separate red/green logs supply the actual CLI proof.

evidence: svg-caption-red-001 records runScrape/Defuddle losing the caption after the SVG image assertion passed: 1 failed, 14 passed.
svg-caption-green-001 records the repaired source passing that same suite on Vitest 4.1.11: 15 passed.
The repair replaces each protected SVG image in place with a token and moves every enclosing figure child to the figure's former position, preserving direct caption and HTML siblings in source order.
a_acceptance.open: No independent extension UI capture-and-copy check of a captioned article is recorded. The existing Mathspace reference establishes composite SVG handling, not caption preservation.

evidence: The original regression uses the real runScrape pipeline and a pre-fix failing caption assertion, so it catches the observed data loss rather than only asserting an SVG was present.

faab76c1 adds source cases for two distinct captioned figures with image count, unique captions, and interleaved Markdown marker order, and for a layered SVG, caption, label, and separate regular article image. These were inspected as source follow-up only; this lane claims no run of them.
remaining_cases: Run the new ordered multi-figure and layered SVG cases under the resource guard and retain their actual result receipt.
Add an ordinary img inside the same SVG figure, then assert both images, caption, and HTML label remain in source order without duplication; faab76c1's ordinary img is outside the figure.
Exercise an ordinary non-SVG article through the same pipeline to check for image or text duplication outside the protected-figure path.
b_doctrine_quality.test_limit: The new layered case asserts caption and label presence, but does not assert graphic-to-caption-to-label order; the two-figure case does assert its listed marker sequence. Neither new case has a run receipt in this review.

acceptance_position: Full remote-stack acceptance remains open for the integrated release run, guarded new-case results, and independent extension UI proof.
